# Timglas

> Timglas is a local-first, menu-bar time tracker for macOS (14+), built for freelancers, consultants and independent professionals who bill by the hour. No account, no cloud, no analytics, no telemetry, no subscription. Status: in development; not yet released.

## What it does
- Menu bar timer: start, stop, pause and switch from the menu bar or a global hotkey; full window for the whole picture
- Automatic tracking rules by front app, window title, URL or time of day; suggestions never override a manual timer
- Idle detection: asks what an absence was (keep, drop or assign) instead of guessing
- Built for imperfect days: backfill unrecorded time, split entries, label timeline gaps
- Projects with hourly or fixed-price billing, budgets, billable states and revenue reports
- Optional Pomodoro rhythm over the running timer
- Export to CSV, JSON, iCalendar and PDF; import CSV
- Shortcuts, Siri, Spotlight and timglas:// URL integration
- Native Swift and SwiftUI, no third-party dependencies

## Privacy and data
- All data is a readable JSON file on the user's Mac with rotating daily backups
- Nothing is sent anywhere; works fully offline
- Rules read only what they need (an app rule never reads window titles)

## Good fit for
- Freelancers and consultants on macOS who need billable totals they trust
- People who want a private, offline time tracker with no account
- People who forget to start or stop timers and need to fix their history cheaply
